verdict.rationale: Elastic documents a REST endpoint for ES|QL queries, with machine-readable output formats and request-body parameters. It also documents running Elastic Agent standalone inside a container. Both are first-party ways to drive the product programmatically without the UI, but nothing shows a CLI, CI pipeline usage, or end-to-end headless automation workflows. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI integration docs, API coverage beyond querying (e.g. managing rules or SLOs as code), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
